summary:
LunaTrack is an interactive web-based Moon Phase Tracker designed to help people 
understand and explore the changing phases of the Moon. Our project allows users to 
select or update any date and time to view the corresponding Moon phase through an 
interactive visual display.
The application identifies the Moon’s phase and displays its appearance, illumination 
percentage, phase name and a simple explanation. Users can explore the lunar cycle 
through its eight main phases: New Moon, Waxing Crescent, First Quarter, Waxing Gibbous, 
Full Moon, Waning Gibbous, Third Quarter and Waning Crescent. An interactive lunar 
calendar helps users understand how the Moon changes over time.
Our solution makes learning about astronomy simple, visual and accessible. Instead of 
depending only on textbooks or static pictures, users can explore Moon phases for different 
dates and understand the science behind them.
This project supports space science education by connecting users with lunar information 
and official NASA resources. By making astronomical concepts interactive and easy to 
understand, LunaTrack encourages curiosity, scientific learning and interest in space 
exploration.
details:
LunaTrack is an interactive web-based application that allows users to explore and understand the different phases of the Moon by selecting any date and time. When a user updates the date and time, the application calculates the corresponding lunar phase and displays the Moon's appearance, phase name and illumination percentage.
The application covers all eight major phases of the Moon: New Moon, Waxing Crescent, First Quarter, Waxing Gibbous, Full Moon, Waning Gibbous, Third Quarter and Waning Crescent. It also includes an interactive lunar calendar, phase descriptions and visual representations to help users understand how the Moon changes throughout its approximately 29.5-day cycle.


Benefits: LunaTrack makes astronomy easier and more interesting through interactive visual learning. Students, teachers and space enthusiasts can explore lunar phases without depending only on textbooks or static images. Users can also investigate how the Moon appeared on past dates and how it is expected to appear on future dates.
Intended Impact: Our goal is to increase interest in astronomy and space science by making lunar information accessible, understandable and engaging for everyone. The project encourages scientific curiosity and promotes space education through technology.


Tools and Technologies: We use HTML to structure the website, CSS to create an attractive and responsive space-themed interface, and JavaScript to handle date and time selection and lunar calculations. An astronomical calculation library is used to determine the Moon's phase and illumination. NASA Scientific Visualization Studio lunar resources are used as an official reference for astronomical information and validation. GitHub is used for source-code management and project collaboration. No specialised hardware is required.


Creativity and Innovation: LunaTrack combines date-based lunar tracking, realistic Moon visualisation, an eight-phase explorer and a monthly lunar calendar in one interactive platform. Its time-exploration feature allows users to travel through different dates and discover how the Moon changes over time.


Factors Considered:During development, we considered astronomical accuracy, user-friendly design, accessibility, mobile responsiveness, reliable NASA references, correct date and time handling, and simplicity of educational content. We aim to make the application useful for both beginners and people interested in astronomy.
